title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) expected to practice Friday
items.desc: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said he expects Dontayvion Wicks to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Wicks was added to the injury report on Friday with a hamstring issue. A practice of any kind on Friday is a good sign for his availability heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalon Daniels planning to start Week 6
items.desc: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that the team is planning to start QB Jalon Daniels in Week 6 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Daniels led the Bucs to their first win of the season on Thursday against the Cowboys. It appears Baker Mayfield will miss at least one more week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kiko Mauigoa (quad) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kiko Mauigoa has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Mauigoa was unable to practice all week. He will be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) to return Sunday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) will be active for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Taylor has missed each of the last two weeks due to a thumb injury, but the second-year TE will be back for Sunday's game. Jeremy Ruckert and Jelani Woods figure to see fewer snaps as a result.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) 'unlikely' to play in Week 5
items.desc: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas is considered "unlikely" for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Douglas is expected to practice in some capacity on Friday. It won't be enough for him to play on Sunday, but he'll have a chance to return in Week 6.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) out for Week 5
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will not play in Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Mitchell will miss a third straight game due to his finger injury. Sterling Shepard should continue to see increased playing time in Mitchell's stead. Tim Patrick (groin) may also see action for the first time this season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) will not play in Week 5
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) will sit out Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: This was an expected development with Hall, but now it is official. Braelon Allen, who saw a whopping 94% of the snaps in Week 4, will step into a workhorse role once again.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) out for Week 5
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) will not play Sunday against the Browns.
items.impact: Parham will miss a second straight game due to a knee injury. Jordan Meredith should continue starting in Parham's stead.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: CeeDee Lamb sustains quad injury Thursday night
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb injured his quad during Thursday night's loss to the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Lamb finished Thursday's game with only two receptions on five targets for a total of nine yards. He bounced in and out of the contest after sustaining a quad injury, but he was clearly in pain and simply could not do much for the Cowboys' offense. On a positive note, the injury is considered to be mild, and the extra rest following a Thursday game should give Lamb time to recuperate.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The star cornerback was unable to practice again on Thursday. He's still managing an ankle injury, and it remains to be seen whether or not it will leave him sidelined in Week 5. Denver's secondary will be much weaker than usual if it does.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) did not take part in Denver's practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Bryant was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday after recently suffering an ankle injury. He is unlikely to play in Week 5, which will open the door for Troy Franklin to see more work than usual against the Chargers on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Adam Trautman (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Adam Trautman (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday, despite being limited by a shoulder injury on Wednesday. He should be available to play against the Chargers on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Donte Jackson (hamstring) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Donte Jackson (hamstring) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson was unable to practice again on Thursday, which makes him playing this weekend seem like a long-shot. Los Angeles' secondary will face an uphill battle against the Broncos this week if Jackson is unavailable to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thompson was limited by his quad injury on Wednesday, but he was downgraded on Thursday and wasn't able to practice at all. He may be sidelined in Week 5, which would be untimely with Ladd McConkey (foot) and Quentin Johnston (chest) also uncertain to play for the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) did not participate at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to take part in practice on either Wednesday or Thursday. He's dealing with a hamstring injury right now and seems likely to be sidelined in Week 5, which will leave Los Angeles' defense weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against the Broncos.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) was absent from Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Awosika didn't practice again on Thursday due to an issue with his fibula. The Chargers are set to be without several key linemen in Week 5, and their situation will only get worse if Awosika is also unable to play in a tough matchup against the Broncos.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashawn Slater (ankle) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Rashawn Slater (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Slater is going to be sidelined in Week 5 after missing two-straight practices to start the week. Los Angeles is dealing with several other injuries to key starters on their offensive line right now, so they seem to be in a lot of trouble ahead of a tough matchup against the Broncos in Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) did not take part in Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey was not able to practice for a second-straight day on Thursday. He's still dealing with a foot injury, and it may very well leave him sidelined this week. Look for Tre' Harris and Quentin Johnston (chest) to see more work if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end seems to be nearing a return to the lineup after missing some time due to a forearm injury. He was limited for another practice on Thursday, and we should know more about his official status sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A chest injury has left Johnston limited at two-straight practices to start the week. He may very well be left with an injury designation heading into the weekend, and Tre' Harris will be primed for more work if Johnston is unable to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) misses practice again Thursday
items.desc: Joe Alt (neck) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Thursday marks two-straight practices that Alt has missed due to a neck issue. The team doesn't expect him to play in Week 5, which will leave their offensive line much weaker than usual in a matchup against a tough Broncos' defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Leonard Williams (ankle) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Leonard Williams (ankle) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Williams was able to practice on Wednesday, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday and seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 5. Seattle's defensive front will be much weaker than usual if he's out this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Irv Charles (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Irv Charles (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Charles recently had his 21-day practice window opened and has been limited at practice all week. He may play in Week 5, and we should know more about his official injury designation sometime within the next 24 hours.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (rest) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (rest) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba returned to practice on Thursday after getting Wednesday off as a rest day. He should be good to go for Week 5 and projects to continue to be a dominant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Holani (ribs) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: George Holani (ribs) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Holani was limited again on Thursday as he continues to nurse a nagging issue with his ribs. It looks like he'll play in Week 5, however, and he will continue to serve as a depth option for the Seahawks moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Charbonnet continues to draw closer to a return to the lineup, as he was able to practice in a limited fashion again on Thursday. We should get more clarity on his status for Week 5 after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Juszczyk was sidelined on Thursday again due to the same knee injury that has been bothering him for a while. He might not play this week, which would be less than ideal for San Francisco's offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs) missed San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Evans was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He was able to play through the injury last week, however, so he still projects to do the same again in Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) was a non-participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa missed another practice on Thursday due to two different injuries. He looks unlikely to play in Week 5, but we won't know for sure until the team releases their final injury report of the week tomorrow.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kaelon Black (illness) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Kaelon Black (illness) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Black was limited by an illness on Wednesday, but he's over it at this point and was able to practice in full on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 5 and will continue to be San Francisco's RB2 for as long as he remains healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) off injury report for Week 5
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) is off of the injury report heading into Week 5.
items.impact: Nacua was able to make his return to the lineup last week and is now off of the injury report entirely heading into Week 5. Fantasy managers should have no hesitations starting him as a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tez Johnson snags long pass in win
items.desc: Tez Johnson caught his only target for 64 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Johnson may not have had a big role, but he had a big moment in the second half, getting left wide open on broken coverage and making the longest play of the night aside from Bucky Irving's 72-yard scamper. Johnson doesn't have a big role at the moment with most everyone healthy, so he's not worth rostering.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Watson (shoulder) limited Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Watson (shoulder) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Watson was limited on Thursday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise after missing last week's game due to a shoulder injury. Los Angeles' secondary will be weaker than usual if he's out for another week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Davante Adams (rest) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Davante Adams (rest) did not take part in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Rams gave Adams the day off as a veteran rest day on Thursday. He should be back at practice on Friday and should be a full go for Monday night, looking to bounce back after an underwhelming performance in Week 4.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Sean Tucker sees goal line work in win over Dallas
items.desc: Sean Tucker ran five times for 18 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Tucker had at least one goal-line attempt in this game, somewhat impacting his yards per carry. He was ruled stopped short on that attempt, taking away a potential touchdown. He's firmly the third back in the Tampa Bay backfield right now. However, should anything happen to either of the two backs in front of him, he is an interesting addition for fantasy.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cade Otton catches three passes in win
items.desc: Cade Otton caught three of four targets for 25 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
items.impact: Otton had two of his three catches on the first drive, and wasn't heard from much afterwards. The passing offense under Jaylon Daniels is still effective, just not explosive. Things get done, but maybe not in a fantasy-friendly manner. That's going to hurt Otton's fantasy value until something changes.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kenny Gainwell sees limited work on Thursday night
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran four times for 18 yards and caught three of four targets for 10 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
items.impact: Gainwell was fine on his rushing touches, but his receiving was a little lackluster. True, a play did get blown up on one of his receptions, but that's little comfort for his fantasy production. He is firmly the RB2 of the offense and should be treated as such.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. snags three passes in win
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday. He also ran once for three yards.
items.impact: Godwin started off hot with two catches on the first drive, but fizzled out quickly with only a single catch the rest of the way. Emeka Egbuka was the favorite target of rookie QB Jaylon Daniels, with Godwin sitting tied for third on the team in targets behind Cade Otton and Kenny Gainwell. Godwin is a risky start at this point, and his value is more closely tied to real life than to fantasy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Mumpfield's shoulder injury is nothing serious, as he was able to log a full practice session to start the week on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 5.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Emeka Egbuka runs in touchdown in win
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught six of nine targets for 38 yards, also running once for a 14-yard score in Tampa Bay's 24-16 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Egbuka had a long of 21 yards, meaning his five other receptions amounted to just 17 total yards. He was still the highest-targeted Bucs receiver on the night, with no other Tampa player garnering more than four targets. He doesn't have quite the same appeal he might have if a veteran were tossing him the ball, but Daniels has shown competence so far in his two starts while QB Baker Mayfield recovers from injury, and should only get better.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parkinson didn't play last week due to a pair of injuries that he's dealing with, and he was limited at Thursday's practice for the same reason. He seems likely to play on Monday night, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Donald (back) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Donald (back) was limited at Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at Los Angeles' first practice of the week after being sidelined by a back issue last week. That's a good sign for his Week 5 availability, and the team is reportedly hopeful that he's going to play against the Bills on Monday night.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bucky Irving rumbles for 165 yards in win over Dallas
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 yards and a touchdown, as well as catching two passes for 10 additional yards and a score in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Irving struggled to get going in this game, but finished off the Bucs' first drive with a touchdown catch. He then started to see holes open up in the defensive line as the game went on and made Dallas pay for it. He did cede a goal-line touch to Sean Tucker, but Tucker was ruled short of the plane on his attempt to punch in a score. Bucky has been a bit up and down so far this year, but in the right matchup, he's certainly a strong start.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) limited Thursday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to his nagging groin issue. His absence would be less than ideal for the Texans in a divisional matchup against Tennessee on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aireontae Ersery (illness) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Aireontae Ersery (illness) missed Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Houston's starting left tackle was unable to practice on Thursday due to an illness. He should recover in time for Sunday's game, but it could leave him on the injury report heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Ingram (illness) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Ed Ingram (illness) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ingram was one of several Houston offensive linemen out on Thursday due to illness. He should be good to go for Week 5 still, but Friday's injury report will tell us his official status.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) returns to practice in full Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (foot) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was held out of Wednesday's practice as part of the injury management for his foot, but he was able to return to practice in a full capacity on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 5 and will see his usual workload in a matchup against the Texans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carnell Tate (knee) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Carnell Tate (knee) was limited at Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie is a new addition to the team's injury report, being listed with a knee injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Thursday. He had a good game in Week 4 and seems to be finding his groove right now, but an untimely injury could mess up that momentum. Look for Wan'Dale Robinson to see more work if Tate is out this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Gunnar Helm (knee) downgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Gunnar Helm (knee) was downgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Helm seems to have suffered a knee injury of some kind, as he was downgraded to a limited participant on Thursday because of it. Daniel Bellinger will see more work if Helm is unable to suit up against the Texans this week.
